note: Ruling 2: each screen is captured ONCE from a real application and must hold NO personal data - the repository is public, and every screen is sent to the model on every turn. A screen is usable by a live run only when its sha256 below matches the file AND reviewed is true; capture.py sets both only through its --review step, after Sultan has looked at the image. Follow scripts/harness/CAPTURE_GUIDE.md step by step.

desktop.shows: the plain desktop only - no window, no desktop icon, a solid background (CAPTURE_GUIDE.md, screen 1)

editor_save.shows: Paint filling the screen, one line on the canvas, its save-your-changes question open with a button labelled Save (CAPTURE_GUIDE.md, screen 2)

editor_code.shows: VS Code filling the screen, explain_me.py as its only tab, its line numbers and the path above the code visible (CAPTURE_GUIDE.md, screen 3)

notepad_text.shows: a new Notepad window filling the screen, one Untitled tab holding three neutral lines, nothing highlighted (CAPTURE_GUIDE.md, screen 4)
